note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: import $env:TEMP\cin-data.zip in the browser (Solutions > Import solution), then import src/data/*.csv in the order inspectors, sites, inspections, items (autonumber seed 1000), give sam.demo Basic User and the Power Apps self-service trial. Press Enter'

screens.name: tables
steps: Solutions > Contoso Inspections > Objects: the four tables
Open Inspections > Data: eight rows INS-01000 to INS-01007
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: app-designer
steps: New > App > Model-driven app, name Inspection Back Office
Add pages Dashboard, Inspections, Findings, Sites, Inspectors
Navigation: one area, groups Overview, Review (Inspections, Findings), Reference (Sites, Inspectors)
Save, publish, play
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: quick-create
steps: In the running app click + New > Inspection
Quick create panel: Site, Inspector, Inspection date
Create one for Harbor Warehouse and Alex Demo: the next number INS-01008
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: forms
steps: Inspection table > Forms > main form in the designer
Header: Status, Score, Inspection date, Owner
Tabs General, Findings (sub grid) and Review (Reviewer notes)
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: views
steps: Running app > Inspections: open the view picker
Active Inspections, then Inspections to review (three rows), Needs follow-up
Inspection items: Open critical findings
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: business-rule
steps: Inspection table > Business rules > 'A submitted inspection needs a score' in the designer (scope Table)
In the app set INS-01006 to Submitted with an empty score and save: error on Score, no save
Critical item with Passed ticked: error on save
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: bpf
steps: Solutions > Inspection review: the business process flow designer, four stages and their required steps
Open INS-01003 in the app: the process bar and the stage flyout
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: dashboard
steps: Open the app's Overview dashboard
Show both charts (Inspections by status, Open findings by severity) and both lists
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: command-bar
steps: App designer > Inspections page > ... > Edit command bar > Main form (choose Power Fx)
Select Approve: label, icon, Visible and Action formulas
In the app on INS-01004 click Approve: confirm dialog and notification
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: review-board
steps: Open INS-01002 and click Review board
Show the red score badge (64), '1 open critical', pass rate 33%, decision 'Reject: open critical findings', two findings
Click Open inspection: back on the form
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: security
steps: Admin center (https://admin.powerplatform.microsoft.com/) > DEV > Settings > Users + permissions > Security roles > Inspection Back Office: privileges grid
Field security profiles > Inspection reviewer notes: Reviewer notes with Read, Create, Update and Sam Demo
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: sam-demo
steps: Open an InPrivate window and sign in as sam.demo
The app is in the list; Overview loads; INS-01004 opens; the Review tab shows Reviewer notes and Sam can type
Admin center: remove sam.demo from the field security profile, reload: lock icon and no value; add Sam back
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: export
steps: Solutions > Contoso Inspections: show tables, app, dashboard, charts, roles
Export > Managed (and Unmanaged for the repo)
Cutaway terminal (offline): pac solution unpack -z <downloaded>.zip -f $env:TEMP\exported, then Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP\exported
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: reset INS-01003/01004 status and follow-up flags; remove the roles and field security profile from sam.demo unless episode 11 needs them; keep the solution Contoso Inspections for episode 11; close the InPrivate window.'
